note: Provider identity is an extensible lowercase string, not a generated enum. Every SDK must be able to express a provider it was not compiled against, and must transmit the value unchanged rather than normalizing it. The Runtime is the only component that decides which providers an installation accepts.
rejected_note: A model family is never a provider. These reach the Runtime unchanged and are refused before durable admission with the existing unsupported-provider error, which is also how a provider whose adapter this deployment does not install is refused.
